race.comment: DUNQUIN (1) showed a stack of grit first up from the wide barrier when a narrow second over 1200m at Mudgee. Comes up with the good gate and ready to go one better. COSMOLICIOUS (2) made an eye-catching return with the 60.5kg for a tough third over 1000m at Scone. Andrew Gibbons retains the ride and she can tick off the 1200m box here. LA POTENZA (7) has been in the market at her last couple of starts since resuming but hasn't made an impression, last start running ninth at Moree. Can improve and worth including. GOLDEN VADER (3) ran a better race last start to finish second at Mudgee over 1200m. One for consideration.
